derivation: from H5130 (נוּף) in the sense of lifting;

occurrences.text: And to the kings that were on the north of the mountains, and of the plains south of Chinneroth, and in the valley, and in the borders of Dor on the west,
The king of Dor in the coast of Dor, one; the king of the nations of Gilgal, one;
The son of Abinadab, in all the region of Dor; which had Taphath the daughter of Solomon to wife:

And his breath, as an overflowing stream, shall reach to the midst of the neck, to sift the nations with the sieve of vanity: and there shall be a bridle in the jaws of the people, causing them to err.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
